Package chess.pieces

Class Bishop

java.lang.Object
chess.pieces.Piece
chess.pieces.Bishop
public class Bishop extends Piece
A bishop, which moves any number of squares diagonally. Its path must be clear, and it can capture the first enemy piece in its way.
